justifications.goal_fidelity: the node assembles the 36 saddle loops as full cylindrical contours through the io_magnetics reader (saddle_sensor_class) and drives them into the benchmark's ConstraintSet/harmonic_design owners, then measures held-out whitened residual against a saddle-removed and a geometry-permuted control; its verdict (attributable false, signs_promoted empty) is the correct refusal because the permuted control's gain (0.8788) does not fall below the real gain (0.8732), so the loop placement is not identified.
justifications.reuse: the reader is repaired in the owner nova/imas/io_magnetics.py (the path the plan mandates) and the saddle assembly extends the existing owners ConstraintSet/assemble/harmonic_design/ring_source_design in nova/imas/mast_misfit_harmonics.py rather than adding a parallel path; the benchmark imports resolve_machine_artifact and refuses to run if nova.catalog.mast_geometry is imported (benchmarks/mast_saddle_admission.py:701), honouring the retirement constraint.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-status fe057dcc5 c3cc4e044 lists ten paths, all inside the manifest's declared write roots (the two source owners, the benchmark, the two test files, docs/figures/mast-saddle-admission and the one evidence fragment); no file under nova/, tests/ or benchmarks/ is touched outside that set, and the tree is clean at the reviewed head.

notes: Independent review of r-20261008T055143084501-mast-saddle-admission at head c3cc4e044f347e3088e38eb8daf664f5f75a256b against base fe057dcc5259a8ba801e863f5c63ae963eec59d3. The node repairs the broken Magnetics.sensor_identity rule, which read the producer's version_put metadata via get_ids rather than the opened schema, and admits the 36 saddle loops as full cylindrical flux contours integrated by contour_flux. It then measures held-out admission against a saddle-removed control (gain 0.0 by construction, as the reference arm) and a geometry-permuted control (gain 87.88%), and correctly refuses to attribute the 87.32% real gain. The measurement rests on two training and one held-out shot (three shots carry the 36 saddles), so the dense gain is a limited diagnostic, a limit the node states (single_held_out_diagnostic true, cross_shot_uncertainty null). Every claim in the manifest reconciles with the logs, the control reddens the guarded contract, and the eight baseline failures are the head tests failing against the base module, giving zero added failures. Two follow-on findings (private ids._dd_version binding; an unexplained fifth excluded channel) do not block. The full-cohort admission and any traversal-sign promotion remain unproven and are the plan's next. The after_suite log's header prints the code head 0726059, while c3cc4e044 is a docs-only tail, so the reviewed source under review is fully covered by the gate.
